title: Halos root
description: The policy repo root document (halos.yaml). The simple-mode keys (tools, provider, models, gateway, telemetry, team, safety, rollout) expand into the Gateway, the default Profile and the Rings; see `halo explain`.

identity.description: The org's OIDC provider (any compliant IdP: Okta, Entra ID, Google, Keycloak, Ping, Auth0...). Used by the portal, halo-proxy / halo-kong and enrollment.

issuer.description: OIDC issuer URL; discovery is fetched from <issuer>/.well-known/openid-configuration.

clientID.description: OAuth client id used by the portal.

audience.description: Audience expected in gateway bearer tokens; defaults to clientID.

userClaim.description: JWT claim holding the user id (default "email").

groupsClaim.description: JWT claim holding the user's groups (default "groups").

adminGroups.description: Groups that may approve requests and manage experiments in the portal.

enabled.description: Turn the portal's self-service features on.

requestable.description: Kinds of access developers may request (approval opens a policy PR).

catalog.description: MCP servers developers may request that aren't in their profile yet.

enrollmentTTLSeconds.description: Lifetime of one-time laptop bootstrap tokens (default 900).

tools.description: Simple mode: harnesses to enable, each pinned to an exact CLI version: a bare version, or {version, model} where model is a models alias the tool starts on instead of default.

model.description: A models alias this tool starts on instead of default.

provider.description: Simple mode: where models run. A name, or a mapping with its settings.

region.description: AWS region (bedrock, default us-east-1) or Vertex region (default global).

url.description: Override the provider's base URL (e.g. an internal orchestrator).

models.description: Simple mode: model alias -> provider model id, or a list of ids in failover order. An id may be prefixed <provider>/ (required with provider multi). The default alias is required.

gateway.description: Simple mode: the gateway base URL clients are pointed at.

telemetry.description: Simple mode: OTLP/HTTP endpoint. Telemetry is always on.

team.description: Simple mode: ring0 members, IdP groups or user ids (containing @). Default: identity.adminGroups, else <org>-ai-platform.

safety.description: Simple mode: safety preset (default standard). No preset bypasses permissions.

rollout.description: Simple mode: rollout preset (rings and step template; default standard).
